title: Privacy Policy
content:
About this policy

This policy explains how FGX MART handles information in connection with this website, customer accounts, product enquiries and orders. For questions or requests about your information, contact FGX MART using the company contact details shown in the website footer or checkout.

Information you provide

When you create an account, we collect information such as your name, email address and account credentials. Saved addresses and checkout may include your recipient name, phone number, postal address, country and zipcode. We also receive product selections, quantities, order details, review ratings and comments, and information you choose to share in support conversations.

How information is used

We use this information to operate customer accounts, remember product selections, manage addresses, handle enquiries and orders, communicate with you, display customer reviews and maintain the website. Information may also be used to investigate technical issues, prevent misuse and meet applicable recordkeeping obligations.

Browser storage and authentication

The website uses browser storage to remember your country and zipcode, guest cart, wishlist and customer sign-in state. Authentication and administration also use session-related information and cookies. Clearing browser storage or changing devices can remove remembered selections or sign you out. Browser controls can restrict cookies and storage, although some features may then stop working as expected.

Analytics and technical information

The website is configured to use Google Analytics to understand visits and interactions such as viewing products and adding items to the cart. Analytics and hosting services may process device, browser, usage and technical connection information and may use cookies or similar technologies. Their processing is also subject to the providers' own privacy information.

PDF downloads and WhatsApp

A downloaded proforma invoice may contain your selected products and any delivery or billing details included in it. The PDF is saved to your device. If you attach it in WhatsApp or send it by email, you choose to share that document through that service. WhatsApp and email providers operate independently and apply their own privacy practices.

Public product reviews

When you publish a product review, your display name, star rating, comment and review date are visible to other visitors. Your email address is not displayed with the review. Please avoid including phone numbers, addresses, payment information or other sensitive details in a public comment.

Service providers and fulfilment

Information may be processed by hosting, analytics, communication and other service providers used to operate the website and handle requests. Where supply or delivery arrangements require it, relevant recipient and order details may be shared with the parties involved. Information may also be disclosed where required by applicable law.

Keeping and protecting information

How long information is kept depends on the purpose for which it is used, including maintaining your account, responding to enquiries, handling orders and meeting applicable recordkeeping obligations. Contact us for information about records relating to you. We use access controls and authentication to restrict administrative access, but no website or communication service can guarantee absolute security.

Your choices and requests

You can manage saved addresses and account settings through My account and edit your product review. You may contact us to request information about, correction of or deletion of your personal information. Available rights and any limits depend on applicable law and the records involved. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when website features or information-handling practices change. Please revisit this page for the current version and contact FGX MART if you need clarification.
